translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: LUCAS
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni LUCAS

content: Dos Kodsuhu ni Disas to Pittumpuu‑oruwon Minuvu
Nopongnga idda, id aam tod Longaggon iddos pittumpuu‑oruwon minuvu no id pondumoruma kandin, woy id suhu rin sikandan nod unna kandin to tinduwa riyon to ipat bonuwa nod undiyonnan din.

Kahin Disas kandan to, “Iddos mgo minuvu, od poko‑iling to ommoy no ollog don nod kottuwon. Oray'n dakkoo kos od kottuwon, piru disok da kos mgo tohodkottu. De‑en buyuwa row riyot Monama no komunoy taddot ommayon amoy'd popiyod sikandin to mgo tohodkottu.
Na ipanow kowd. Piru pa‑ayyad‑ayyad kow, oyyos od poko‑iling kow to mgo karnero nod isau riyot movuut no mgo tuyyang.
Yo kow'd piyod to soopi, kavii, sandalyas woy yo kow mandad od sambang od totongko to ahad ondoy nod kotommu row riyot daan.
Diyot kod‑usok dow to sokkad no baoy, unna kow vo oseng to, ‘Muopa nod pokotanggap to kosunayan iddos id ubpa ka‑ay'n baoy.’
Na otik moppiya kos kodtanggap koniyu taddot id ubpa tadda, od pokotanggap en sikandan to kosunayan. Piru ko dii ran od tanggap koniyu, konna en mandad idda od puungan to Monama riyot kandan.

Otik duwon od tanggap koniyu, diyon kow vo tahad oubpa to baoy rin taman tod awa kowd taddon bonuwa. Tonggapa row iddos ahad ondan no koka‑an woy'd inommon no id sondad koniyu, oyya su iddos minuvu nod puung, ollog en nod boggayan to langun no ko‑ilonganon din.
Iddos ahad ingkon no bonuwa nod undiyonnan dow woy moppiya kos kodtanggap dan koniyu, kanna row iddos ahad ondan no id sondad dan koniyu.
Bowi‑i row iddos od pongkovohokan woy ponudtuli row iddos mgo minuvu no asow ron kos kodharit Monama.
Piru ko iddos ahad ingkon no bonuwa nod undiyonnan dow, dii od tanggap koniyu, undiyon kow to doraanon woy osengi row iddos mgo minuvu rutun no,
‘Ahad iddos boubbuk to bonuwa row no ka‑ay't pa‑a roy, od podparon doy pe‑en, patow no waa id pokosondit dow konami. Piru ko‑ilangan nod kosorollan dow no asow ron kos kodharit Monama.’
Od ikohiyan ku sikiyu, no riyot allow to kodhukum, movoggat pa kos silut taddot id oubpa taddon bonuwa kuntra taddot mgo toho Sodoma.”
Dos mgo Bonuwa no Waa id Sondit woy'd Tanan to mgo Saa Ran

“Moka‑arat‑arat kod kotomanan dow no mgo toho Corazin woy sikiyu mandad no mgo toho Betsaida! Su mo‑uraa kos id puungan ku no mokososoobbu ruwot koniyu, piru waa kow en id sondit woy'd tanan to mgo saa row. Otik diyon ku pa idda puungi to Tiro woy Sidon, nouhoy ran don nanoy id oumpak to saku woy id ounsad diyot ibmukon, patow to kodsondit woy kodtanan dan to mgo saa ran.
Diyot allow to kodhukum, otik movoggat man kos silut taddot mgo toho Tiro woy Sidon, lampas kow pe‑en.
Woy sikiyu mandad no mgo toho Capernaum, kunan dow ayu kod inguma kow taman to langit. Piru id subbuk kow ra vos en baling diyon to linow't apuy.”

Na mid ikahi si Disas diyot mgo tinodduwan din to, “Iddos ahad ondoy nod pominog koniyu, id pominog a mandad nikandan. Woy dos ahad ondoy nod elle koniyu, id elleyan a mandad nikandan. Iddos ahad ondoy nod elle koddi, id elleyan dan mandad kos Monama nid popiyod koddi.”
Dos Kodlivod taddot Pittumpuu‑oruwa no id Suhu ni Disas

To id livod don iddos pittumpuu‑oruwa no id suhu ni Disas, oraroy ran no nahaa no mid ponudtuu kandin moka‑atag taddot iponawon dan. Kahi ran to, “Longaggon, ahad iddos mgo busow, id dumoruma konami to id poleggua roy ukit to kikow'n ngaran.”
Kahin Disas kandan to, “Nokita ku en si Moivuyan no no‑uug iling to kilat pomon diyot datas to langit.
Yo kow'd kolingow! Id boggayan kud sikiyu to kotungud, amoy ahad od koheddan dow kos mgo uwod woy mgo topilak, dii kow en od komonnu, woy dii kow mandad od kotalu taddot kuntra row no si Moivuyan.
Piru yo kow'd kahaa no id tuman iddos mgo busow to id poleggua row sikandan, ko konna, kahaa kow su iddos ngaran dow, nokosulat don diyot datas to langit.”
Nahaa si Disas

To iddon timpu, nahaa si Disas ukit to Uhis no Ispiritu woy mid ikahi sikandin to, “Amoy ku, sikkow en kos Monama no komunoy to langit woy livuta. Od doongon ku sikkow, su iddos kovonnaan no waa ru id posaddoo riyot mgo minuvu nod ikahi no mopandoy woy moraom kos koovottan, diyon du id posaddoo to mgo minuvu no movavow kos koovottan iling to mgo anak. Oyya en, Amoy ku, od doongon ku sikkow su ini me‑en kos kikow'n id kopi‑i.”

Na mid ikahi si Disas diyot mgo minuvu to, “Id sanna koddi to Amoy ku iddos langun. Oyyos waa osson nokokilaa koddi, idda ra en so Amoy ku, su anak a man nikandin. Woy waa mandad osson nokokilaa to Amoy ku, siyak da en woy dos mgo minuvu no id kopi‑i ku nod pokokilaa kandin.”
Nopongnga idda, mid isau si Disas diyot mgo tinodduwan din woy id osengan din no siksikandan da, kahi rin to, “Moppiya kod kotomanan to mgo minuvu no nokokita taddot nokita row.”

Oyyos od ikohiyan ku sikiyu, no mo‑uraan propeta woy mgo hari no od kopiyan nod pokokita taddot nokita row, piru waa ran en idda nokita. Id kopi‑i ran nod pokorinog taddot norinog dow, piru waa ran en idda norinog.”
Dos Eeruwon no Toho Samaria

Na, duwon tohodnonaw to mgo Suhu ni Moises no id lohinat su id kopi‑i rin nod posaharon si Disas ukit to intud. Kahi rin to, “Tohodnonaw, ondan kos od puungan ku amoy'd kotanggap ku kos umuun waad tomanon?”
Mid tavak si Disas to, “Ondan man kos no‑ikahi riyot mgo Suhu ni Moises no novasa ru?”
Kahi taddot tohodnonaw to,

content.text: “ ‘Ginowanniyu kos Monama nod Longaggon du riyot tivuk no pusung du, diyot tivuk no umuu ru, diyot tivuk no konokkaan du woy riyot tivuk no poomdom du.
Woy ginowanniyu kos duma iling to kodginawa ru to ko‑ugolingun du.’ ”

content: Kahin Disas to, “Ollog kos tavak du. Na, puungiyu ini amoy'd pokotanggap ka to umuun waad tomanon.”
Piru iddon tohodnonaw, diid kopiyan nod potalu, de‑en id intud pe‑en sikandin ki Disas, kahi rin to, “Ondoy man bos kos duma no ollog nod ginowannon?”

Mid tavak si Disas kandin ukit to ponunggelengan, kahi rin to, “Duwon sokkad no minuvu no id undiyon to Jerico pomon diyot Jerusalem. Diyon to daan, id oyanan sikandin to mgo tulisan, id pomodasan sikandin woy id angoy pe-en, ahad iddos sabpong to lawa rin. Nopongnga, id tonanan dan sikandin no asow ron od patoy.
Na, duwon tohodbuwis no id baya rutun. To nokita rin iddos minuvu, id olihuwan din da en.
Iling mandad tadda, id baya rutun iddos sokkad no Levita.
To nokita rin iddos minuvu, id olihuwan din mandad.
Todtahad, duwon minuvu no toho Samaria
no id baya, woy to nokita rin iddos minuvun nopaddoo, iling tid kommos kos pusung din pomon to eru.

Id poroniyan din idda, woy id bowiyan din to lana woy binu iddos mgo paddoo rin woy id bukusan. Nopongnga, id posakoy rin sikandin to asnu amoy od piyoddon diyot baoy nod oowottan. Na rutun, id tuhanuu rin pe‑en sikandin.
So‑op no allow, id boggayan din to soopi iddos komunoy taddot baoy, woy id ikohiyan din to, ‘Tuhonulow vo sikandin woy od boyaran ku sikkow init kodlivod ku otik duwon od kogastu ru kandin.’ ”
Na mid intud si Disas diyot tohodnonaw to mgo Suhu ni Moises, kahi rin to, “Diyot kikow'n poomdom, ondoy musing ka‑ay't otollu kos id pokita to ginawa riyot duma?”
Mid tavak sikandin to, “Iddos no‑eruwan kandin.” Purisu id ikohiyan sikandin ni Disas to, “Na, ungketen be‑en mandad kos ko‑ilangan nod puungan du.”
Dos Kodlowwi ni Disas ki Marta woy ki Maria
Na, to id ponayun onsi Disas to iponawon dan, id inguma ran diyot sokkad no bariyu no id ubpan taddot ba‑ay no id ngoranan ki Marta. Id pa‑allus din onsi Disas diyon to baoy rin.
Duwon ari ni Marta nid ngoranan ki Maria no id unsad diyot morani to pa‑a ni Disas amoy'd pominog to nonaw rin.

Piru si Marta, nolewang nod panoy to koka‑an atag ongki Disas. De‑en id porani sikandin ki Disas woy kahi rin to, “Longaggon, imman to waa ron diyot kikow no id podtohon a to ari ku nod puung to langun? Suhuwow sikandin nod tavang koddi!”
Piru mid tavak iddos Longaggon to, “Ooy kikow, Marta! Oraroy ka nod kaanu woy od kolewang to mo‑uraan pinuungan.
Sokkad da kos duwon dakkoon koru‑anon, woy ini en kos na‑aam ni Maria woy worad en od poko‑angoy tadda pomon diyot kandin.”

footnotes.text: Od kovasa ini riyot Deuteronomio 6:5; Levitico 19:18.
Dos mgo Levita, mgo Judio sikandan no id pomon to lubbad ni Levi. Sikandan iddos tohodtavang to mgo tohodbuwis diyot templo.
Dos mgo Judio woy dos mgo toho Samaria, konna moppiya kos koroniyan dan pomon poron to kovuyyahan dan.
